about: The evening outcome ask's fixed question, read by plugins/av-events/_outcome_ask.py and by install/tests/proactive_jobs.test.ts. The plugin arms only when the model's reply, after the normalise steps (for matching only; the message hash is of the reply as it is), fully matches ^sentence$. A Telegram reply pointer can be an answer only when its quote contains marker; the question sentence is then found in the quote by an unanchored search for sentence. Both suites check every entry of cases.
sentence: Did you and [^?\n]{1,64} meet\? [Rr][Ee][Pp][Ll][Yy] met, not useful, or missed\.?

steps: spaces: each of these characters becomes a plain space
trailing_emoji: strip trailing emoji (Unicode category So, ZWJ, variation selectors, keycap mark, skin tones, tag characters) and whitespace
wrapper: remove one pair of these around the whole reply, the first that fits, if anything is left inside
trailing_emoji: again, for emoji inside the wrapper

key: The question key, hashed with the tenant's key at arm time and for a pointer's quote: the sentence found after normalising, with every *, _, ` and ~ removed, whitespace runs as one space, no final full stop, case-folded.
